title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1+2+2 POSTE PARKIMI NE DELIJORGJ ID: 530281030-932
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1+2+ 2 poste parkimi ne Kompleksin Delijorgji. 
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale 119 m², siperfaqe neto 100.75 m² dhe pozicionohet ne katin e tete. 
Organizohet ne nje korridor shperndares, kuzhine se bashku me dhomen e ndenjies, dy dhoma gjumi, ku njera prej tyre disponon garderobe dhe tualet brenda dhomes, nje tualet tjeter si dhe dalje ne ballkon nga dhoma e ndenjies. 
Apartamenti eshte i pabanuar me pare, i sapo investuar dhe i mobiluar me mobilim cilesor dhe bashkekohor. 
Ne cmim perfshihen edhe dy poste parkimi, te cilat ofrojne hapesire per parkimin e tre makinave.
title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2+2 PARKING POST IN DELIJORGJ ID: 530281030-932
description_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2+ 2 parking spaces in Delijorgji Complex. The apartment has a total area of ​​119 m², net area of ​​100.75 m² and is located on the eighth floor. It is organized in a distribution corridor, kitchen together with the living room, two bedrooms, where one of them has a wardrobe and toilet inside the room, another toilet and exit to the balcony from the living room. The apartment is uninhabited before, newly invested and furnished with quality and contemporary furniture. The price also includes two parking spaces, which offer parking space for three cars.
